Represents a decimal-place precision setting together with its derived base-10 scale factors.

public readonly struct DecimalPrecision

Remarks

This type is useful when converting floating-point values into quantized integer-like values, for example during geometric hashing or when interfacing with systems that operate on scaled coordinates. Supported precision values are clamped to the inclusive range 0 to 16.
